title: The 3 Best Travel Backpacks Under $200
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for travel backpacks under $200, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at travel backpacks under $200 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Osprey Farpoint 40
products.blurb: Key specs: 40L with removable 11L daypack, LightWire frame suspension, Stowable harness.
strengths: Frame suspension and hipbelt are rare features at this price and comfort level
Detachable daypack adds real functional value beyond a single-piece bag
Strong long-term durability track record among frequent travelers
limitations: S/M and M/L sizing requires checking torso length before buying

products.name: Cotopaxi Allpa 35L Travel Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: 35L suitcase-style opening, 1000D TPU-coated polyester, recycled fabrics, Air-mesh back panel.
strengths: Suitcase-style opening packs and unpacks faster than a top-loader
Recycled fabric build backed by a lifetime warranty
limitations: No frame suspension, hip belt is thin compared to the Osprey's harness
35L is on the smaller side for trips over a week
Fewer external organization pockets than pricier packs

products.name: Cotopaxi Allpa 42L Travel Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: 42L suitcase-style opening, 15-inch laptop sleeve, 12.5-inch tablet sleeve, 1000D TPU-coated polyester shell.
strengths: Same fast suitcase-style packing as the 35L version
Dedicated laptop and tablet sleeves are a genuine upgrade over the 35L
limitations: Heavier than the 35L version when fully packed
No frame suspension for heavier loads carried over long distances

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
